name: Single-run sigma_y SNR autoresearch on registered final Tuned
fixed_params_source: base_protocol.params; each run changes exactly one entry of variables
rules: Exactly one approved variable (see variables) changes per run; sampler source, checkpoint, inputs, seeds and evaluator are SHA-pinned.
Every run is reserved in ledger.jsonl before inference; failed runs still count; no automatic retries.
Never overwrite an existing output; old experiment directories are read-only.
Hard structure gates and score come unchanged from the frozen evaluator and base protocol guards.
Confirmation cases are evaluated only after a tuning value is frozen; they never select a setting.
No default/config/registered-result change; adoption requires explicit user approval.
claim_boundary: Same two previously studied scans; proxy SNR and structure-preservation only, no clean truth or external validation.

eta.meaning: reverse-SDE transition-noise scale; drift (1+eta^2)/2, noise eta; 1 = original, 0 = probability-flow

amendments.evidence: sigma_y 0.5 (score 1.319) and 0.35 (score 1.093) both infeasible; 0.35 fails only input-coarse-SSIM drop (.007-.013 > .001); passing sigma_y extrapolates to ~0.303, ~+0.7% SNR
amendments.change: Add eta variable via eta_sampler.py (one-line derived patch of SHA-pinned sampler). Gates, metric, cases, seeds, budget unchanged.
